text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day. At Nishino Flower's request,
we were having an early 'first training session of the year.'

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out to run...!

Lately, she has been pursuing new training to bridge the gap
between the senses she had honed and her altered body.
However...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *pant*... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The timing in my head
just isn't syncing with my legs...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Could we start over
from the dash out of the gates one more time?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I'll practice a whole lot so we can get in sync!

"It seems that intuitive things
are quite difficult to correct after all.
Even so, she remained remarkably positive."

Still, pushing yourself too hard will
take a toll on your mind. In this case...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: Do you want to go on our first shrine visit of the year when we're finished?
Wanna go on our New Year's shrine visit once we're done?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah, there are so many people...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone has
all kinds of wishes on their minds.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was wishing
for everyone's wishes to come true.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, from down here,
we're pretty far from God, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I really hope that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's enjoy
our Hatsumode visit too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What should we start with?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, anmitsu...!
Where is it?
choice_data_list: There were food stalls over that way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Really!
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Lal, la, lala♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"The anmitsu was absolutely delicious, wasn't it?
The shiratama dumplings were so chewy,
and the red bean paste had such a rich sweetness!"
choice_data_list: You looked so happy eating that.
You looked so happy eating that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I love Japanese food!
I'm sure I was all smiles♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want all my friends to try some too.
...I wonder if I can make it at the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think the red bean paste is completely different after all.
It feels like it's been strained very thoroughly, or rather—
Even after that, I chatted with Nishino Flower about anmitsu and spent a peaceful afternoon together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You're right.
We need to make our own wishes too!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There's a line forming over there.
Shall we join it?

Nishino Flower's profile as she prayed was completely earnest.
Following her lead—
choice_data_list: (I pray she has another successful year—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...N-No,
it's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious... but
I probably shouldn't ask...
choice_data_list: ...I asked them to look after you!
...I asked them to look out for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Is that so!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I made lots and lots of wishes
for you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
we made matching wishes, didn't we...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
A breathtaking view?
Actually, I had heard that further up past this shrine lies a small sanctuary with a breathtaking view.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...!
Let's head on out!

And so, I climbed the mountain with Nishino Flower
and took in the view from near the summit.
The scenery from up there was truly magnificent—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“—It felt like another world entirely!
It was so foggy, yet the light was shining through!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It felt just like stepping into a storybook.
To think a place like that really existed...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Could it really
have been the same world?
choice_data_list: Maybe it wandered in by accident.
Maybe it wandered in by accident.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-Well... maybe that's really how it is.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I'm glad we could make it back.
Though that strange world was lovely as well."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because there are still so many sights
I want to see with you, Trainer!
